acceptance.corpus: Unit cube and 20k-face scanned mesh, levels 1-5
acceptance.tolerance: Cube level-1 vertex positions equal published Catmull-Clark masks exactly (1e-12); level-5 under 2 s

statement: Smooth a triangle mesh with Loop subdivision for several levels, keeping naked edges fixed on request.

acceptance.tolerance: Icosahedron level-1 vertex valence 6 for new vertices; masks match Loop 1987 weights within 1e-12

superiority: Variable distance per face or edge, driven from data lists, with guaranteed non-overlapping borders.
